    NA_complex_,
    NA_integer_,
    NA_real_,
    ShinyError,
    Vector,
    WithClass,

def show(value):
    try:
        return "TRUE" if isTruthy(value) else "FALSE"
    except ShinyError as exc:
        return "ERR " + str(exc)

    def btn(value):
        return WithClass(value, ("shinyActionButtonValue",))

    cases = [
        None,
        False,
        True,
        "",
        " ",
        "0",
        "NA",
        Vector([], "character"),
        Vector([], "logical"),
        Vector([], "double"),
        Vector([], "integer"),
        Vector([], "complex"),
        b"",
        NA,
        NA_integer_,
        NA_real_,
        NA_complex_,
        NA_character_,
        Vector([NA, NA, False], "logical"),
        False,
        0.0,
        0,
        Vector([1, 2, 3], "integer"),
        Vector(["a", "b"], "character"),
        Vector([NA, NA, True], "logical"),
        Vector([False, False, True], "logical"),
        WithClass(Vector(["boom"], "character"), ("try-error",)),
        [],
        Vector([NA_real_], "double"),
        Vector([False], "logical"),
        float("nan"),
        float("inf"),
        float("-inf"),
        0j,
        b"\x00",
        Vector([1], "integer"),
        Vector([NA_integer_], "integer"),
        Vector([], "integer"),
        [],
        btn(0),
        btn(1),
        btn(0.0),
        btn("0"),
        btn("a"),
        btn("0.0"),
        Vector(["", ""], "character"),
        Vector(["", "a"], "character"),
        Vector([NA_character_, ""], "character"),
        Vector([NA_character_, "a"], "character"),
        Vector([NA, False], "logical"),
        Vector([False, False], "logical"),
        Vector([0.0, NA_real_], "double"),
        Vector([float("nan"), float("nan")], "double"),
        Vector([float("nan"), 1.0], "double"),
        btn(Vector([0, 1], "integer")),

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(shiny))

fmt_double <- function(v) {
  if (is.nan(v)) return("NaN")
  if (is.na(v)) return("NA")
  if (is.infinite(v)) return(if (v > 0) "Inf" else "-Inf")
  if (v == 0 && (1 / v) < 0) return("-0")
  if (is.finite(v) && v == floor(v) && abs(v) < 1e15) return(sprintf("%.0f", v))
  formatC(v, format = "g", digits = 15, width = 1)
}

tok <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x)) return("NULL")
  suffix <- ""
  cls <- attr(x, "class")
  if (!is.null(cls)) suffix <- paste0("{", paste(cls, collapse = ","), "}")
  nms <- names(x)
  if (!is.null(nms)) suffix <- paste0(suffix, "{names:", paste(nms, collapse = "|"), "}")
  kind <- typeof(x)
  data <- x
  attributes(data) <- NULL
  n <- length(data)
  prefix <- paste0("n=", n, " ")
  if (kind == "raw") {
    body <- if (n == 0) "" else paste(sprintf("%02x", as.integer(data)), collapse = "|")
    return(paste0(prefix, "RAW:", body, suffix))
  }
  if (kind == "complex") {
    parts <- vapply(data, function(v) if (is.na(v)) "<NA>" else gsub(" ", "", as.character(v)), character(1))
    return(paste0(prefix, "CPLX:", paste(parts, collapse = "|"), suffix))
  }
  if (kind == "character") {
    parts <- vapply(data, function(s) if (is.na(s)) "<NA>" else s, character(1))
    return(paste0(prefix, "C:", paste(parts, collapse = "|"), suffix))
  }
  if (kind == "logical") {
    parts <- vapply(data, function(s) {
      if (is.na(s)) "NA" else if (isTRUE(s)) "TRUE" else "FALSE"
    }, character(1))
    return(paste0(prefix, "L:", paste(parts, collapse = "|"), suffix))
  }
  if (kind == "integer") {
    parts <- vapply(data, function(s) if (is.na(s)) "NA" else as.character(s), character(1))
    return(paste0(prefix, "I:", paste(parts, collapse = "|"), suffix))
  }
  if (kind == "double") {
    parts <- vapply(data, fmt_double, character(1))
    return(paste0(prefix, "D:", paste(parts, collapse = "|"), suffix))
  }
  "OTHER"
}

grab <- function(expr) {
  tryCatch(
    {
      vis <- withVisible(eval(expr, envir = parent.frame()))
      paste0("OK vis=", if (isTRUE(vis$visible)) "1" else "0", " ", tok(vis$value))
    },
    error = function(e) {
      paste0("ERR ", paste(class(e), collapse = "/"), "|", conditionMessage(e))
    }
  )
}

import math
import statistics
import string
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from shiny.need import Delayed, Invisible, NeedError, need
from shiny.values import (
    NA,
    NA_character_,
    NA_complex_,
    NA_integer_,
    NA_real_,
    Missing,
    ShinyError,
    Vector,
    WithClass,
)


def fmt_double(value) -> str:
    if isinstance(value, Missing):
        return "NA"
    if math.isnan(value):
        return "NaN"
    if value == math.inf:
        return "Inf"
    if value == -math.inf:
        return "-Inf"
    if value == 0.0 and math.copysign(1.0, value) < 0.0:
        return "-0"
    if math.isfinite(value) and value == math.floor(value) and abs(value) < 1e15:
        return str(int(value))
    return format(value, ".15g")


def fmt_complex(value) -> str:
    if isinstance(value, Missing):
        return "<NA>"
    real = fmt_double(value.real) if not isinstance(value.real, Missing) else "<NA>"
    if math.isnan(value.real) and not isinstance(value, Missing):
        real = "NaN"
    imag = value.imag
    if imag == 0.0:
        return real + "+0i"
    if math.isnan(imag):
        return real + "+NaNi"
    if imag < 0.0:
        return real + "-" + fmt_double(-imag) + "i"
    return real + "+" + fmt_double(imag) + "i"


def tok(value) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return "NULL"
    classes = ()
    names = None
    if isinstance(value, WithClass):
        classes = value.classes
        names = getattr(value.value, "names", None)
        value = value.value
    if isinstance(value, Vector):
        if not classes:
            classes = value.classes
        if names is None:
            names = getattr(value, "names", None)
        data = list(value.data)
        kind = value.mode
    elif isinstance(value, bool):
        data = [value]
        kind = "logical"
    elif isinstance(value, int):
        data = [value]
        kind = "integer"
    elif isinstance(value, float):
        data = [value]
        kind = "double"
    elif isinstance(value, str):
        data = [value]
        kind = "character"
    elif isinstance(value, complex):
        data = [value]
        kind = "complex"
    elif isinstance(value, (bytes, bytearray)):
        data = list(value)
        kind = "raw"
    elif isinstance(value, Missing):
        data = [value]
        kind = value.mode
    else:
        return "OTHER"
    suffix = ""
    if classes:
        suffix += "{" + ",".join(classes) + "}"
    if names is not None:
        suffix += "{names:" + "|".join(names) + "}"
    prefix = f"n={len(data)} "
    if kind == "raw":
        body = "|".join(f"{byte:02x}" for byte in data)
        return prefix + "RAW:" + body + suffix
    if kind == "complex":
        return prefix + "CPLX:" + "|".join(fmt_complex(item) for item in data) + suffix
    if kind == "character":
        parts = ["<NA>" if isinstance(item, Missing) else item for item in data]
        return prefix + "C:" + "|".join(parts) + suffix
    if kind == "logical":
        parts = []
        for item in data:
            if isinstance(item, Missing):
                parts.append("NA")
            elif item is True:
                parts.append("TRUE")
            else:
                parts.append("FALSE")
        return prefix + "L:" + "|".join(parts) + suffix
    if kind == "integer":
        parts = ["NA" if isinstance(item, Missing) else str(item) for item in data]
        return prefix + "I:" + "|".join(parts) + suffix
    if kind == "double":
        return prefix + "D:" + "|".join(fmt_double(item) for item in data) + suffix
    return "OTHER"


def grab(fn) -> str:
    try:
        value = fn()
    except NeedError as exc:
        return "ERR " + "/".join(exc.classes) + "|" + exc.message
    except ShinyError as exc:
        return "ERR simpleError/error/condition|" + str(exc)
    except Exception as exc:
        return "ERR simpleError/error/condition|" + str(exc)
    visible = 1
    if isinstance(value, Invisible):
        visible = 0
        value = value.value
    return f"OK vis={visible} {tok(value)}"


def btn(value):
    return WithClass(value, ("shinyActionButtonValue",))


def factor(labels):
    levels = []
    codes = []
    for lab in labels:
        if lab is None or isinstance(lab, Missing):
            codes.append(NA_integer_)
        else:
            if lab not in levels:
                levels.append(lab)
            codes.append(levels.index(lab) + 1)
    obj = WithClass(Vector(codes, "integer"), ("factor",))
    obj.levels = levels
    return obj


def named_message():
    value = Vector(["x", "y"], "character")
    value.names = ["a", "b"]
    return value

        grab(lambda: need(0.0, False)),

hex <- function(s) {
  if (length(s) == 0 || is.na(s)) s <- ""
  paste(sprintf("%02x", as.integer(charToRaw(s))), collapse = "")
}

fmt <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    return(paste0("s:", hex(x)))

  if (length(x) == 0) return("l:()")

}

proof.r:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(shiny))

fmt_double <- function(x) {
  vapply(x, function(v) {
    if (is.nan(v)) return("NaN")
    if (is.na(v)) return("NA")
    if (is.infinite(v)) return(if (v > 0) "Inf" else "-Inf")
    if (v == 0 && (1 / v) < 0) return("-0")
    formatC(v, format = "g", digits = 15, width = 1)
  }, character(1))
}

tok <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x)) return("NULL")
  if (is.data.frame(x)) return(paste0("DF:", nrow(x), "x", ncol(x)))
  suffix <- ""
  cls <- attr(x, "class")
  if (!is.null(cls)) suffix <- paste0(suffix, "{", paste(cls, collapse = ","), "}")
  nms <- names(x)
  if (!is.null(nms)) suffix <- paste0(suffix, "{names:", paste(nms, collapse = "|"), "}")
  kind <- typeof(x)
  data <- x
  attributes(data) <- NULL
  if (kind == "raw") {
    body <- if (length(data) == 0) "" else paste(sprintf("%02x", as.integer(data)), collapse = "|")
    return(paste0("RAW:", body, suffix))
  }
  if (kind == "complex") {
    return(paste0("CPLX:", paste(gsub(" ", "", as.character(data)), collapse = "|"), suffix))
  }
  if (kind == "character") {
    parts <- vapply(data, function(s) if (is.na(s)) "<NA>" else s, character(1))
    return(paste0("C:", paste(parts, collapse = "|"), suffix))
  }
  if (kind == "logical") {
    parts <- vapply(data, function(s) {
      if (is.na(s)) "NA" else if (isTRUE(s)) "TRUE" else "FALSE"
    }, character(1))
    return(paste0("L:", paste(parts, collapse = "|"), suffix))
  }
  if (kind == "integer") {
    parts <- vapply(data, function(s) if (is.na(s)) "NA" else as.character(s), character(1))
    return(paste0("I:", paste(parts, collapse = "|"), suffix))
  }
  if (kind == "double") {
    return(paste0("D:", paste(fmt_double(data), collapse = "|"), suffix))
  }
  if (kind == "list") return(paste0("LIST:", length(x), suffix))
  "OTHER"
}

grab <- function(expr) {
  tryCatch(
    {
      val <- eval(expr, envir = parent.frame())
      paste0("OK ", tok(val))
    },
    error = function(e) {
      paste0("ERR ", paste(class(e), collapse = "/"), "|", conditionMessage(e))
    }
  )
}

        return real + "-" + fmt_double(0.0) + "i"
    if math.copysign(1.0, imag) < 0 and imag != 0.0:
        return real + "-" + fmt_double(abs(imag)) + "i"
    return real + "+" + fmt_double(imag) + "i"


def tok(value) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return "NULL"
    if isinstance(value, DataFrame):
        return f"DF:{value.nrow}x{value.ncol}"
    classes = ()
    names = None
    if isinstance(value, WithClass):
        classes = value.classes
        names = getattr(value.value, "names", None)
        value = value.value
    if isinstance(value, Vector):
        if not classes:
            classes = value.classes
        if names is None:
            names = getattr(value, "names", None)
        data = list(value.data)
        kind = value.mode
    elif isinstance(value, bool):
        data = [value]
        kind = "logical"
    elif isinstance(value, int):
        data = [value]
        kind = "integer"
    elif isinstance(value, float):
        data = [value]
        kind = "double"
    elif isinstance(value, str):
        data = [value]
        kind = "character"
    elif isinstance(value, complex):
        data = [value]
        kind = "complex"
    elif isinstance(value, (bytes, bytearray)):
        data = list(value)
        kind = "raw"
    elif type(value).__name__ == "Missing":
        data = [value]
        kind = value.mode
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        data = value
        kind = "list"
    else:
        return "OTHER"
    suffix = ""
    if classes:
        suffix += "{" + ",".join(classes) + "}"
    if names is not None:
        suffix += "{names:" + "|".join(names) + "}"
    if kind == "raw":
        return "RAW:" + "|".join(f"{byte:02x}" for byte in data) + suffix
    if kind == "complex":
        return "CPLX:" + "|".join(fmt_complex(item) for item in data) + suffix
    if kind == "character":
        parts = ["<NA>" if type(item).__name__ == "Missing" else item for item in data]
        return "C:" + "|".join(parts) + suffix
    if kind == "logical":
        parts = []
        for item in data:
            if type(item).__name__ == "Missing":
                parts.append("NA")
            elif item is True:
                parts.append("TRUE")
            else:
                parts.append("FALSE")
        return "L:" + "|".join(parts) + suffix
    if kind == "integer":
        parts = ["NA" if type(item).__name__ == "Missing" else str(item) for item in data]
        return "I:" + "|".join(parts) + suffix
    if kind == "double":
        return "D:" + "|".join(fmt_double(item) for item in data) + suffix
    if kind == "list":
        return f"LIST:{len(data)}{suffix}"
    return "OTHER"


def grab(fn) -> str:
    try:
        return "OK " + tok(fn())
    except SilentError as exc:
        return "ERR " + "/".join(exc.classes) + "|" + exc.message
    except MissingDotError as exc:
        return "ERR " + "/".join(exc.classes) + "|" + exc.message
    except ShinyError as exc:
        return "ERR simpleError/error/condition|" + str(exc)
    except Exception as exc:
        return "ERR simpleError/error/condition|" + str(exc)

def encode(value) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return "NULL"
    if isinstance(value, list):

    if isinstance(value, str):

    if isinstance(value, Missing):

        if value.mode == "character":

        if value.mode == "complex":

        if value.mode == "double":
            return "NA_real_"
        return "NA"
    if isinstance(value, float):
        if math.isnan(value):
            return "NaN"
        return "D(" + str(value) + ")"
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "TRUE" if value else "FALSE"
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return "I(" + str(value) + ")"
    if isinstance(value, complex):
        if math.isnan(value.real) or math.isnan(value.imag):

        return "CX"
    return "O"
